background: UBS Group is Switzerland's only remaining global bank after absorbing Credit Suisse, the world's largest wealth manager, with Swiss retail and corporate banking, asset management and an investment bank, and a balance sheet far larger than the Swiss economy.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, at A on average with the weakest of them at A-, both on a stable outlook, and the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 14 Apr 2026: holding-company grades that sit below the operating bank's. The site holds no peer group for the group, so the ratios stand on their own: CET1 is 14.4%, leverage 5.8%, LCR 177% and NSFR 115%, and none has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is mixed: a money-laundering fine on 3 Aug 2026, set against an earlier trading-led profit surge. The Credit Suisse integration and the Swiss debate over capital requirements are the things to watch.
